text: {"distance_m": 4.5, "reasoning_short": "Rough estimate: the spot is visible out to about 4–5 m. At 5% contrast the spot must subtend roughly 3 arcmin, which I take from approximate recall of Blackwell's detection data for normal indoor light. 3 arcmin is about 8.7e-4 rad, so the distance is 0.004 m ÷ 8.7e-4 ≈ 4.6 m. Note that 20/20 acuity (about 1 arcmin) does not set this limit. At such low contrast, contrast sensitivity is the limiting factor."}
